caption:
Credit mix is only about 10% of a FICO Score. 🟡

That means you don't need to take out a loan you don't need just to look 'diverse'. Payment history (35%) and amounts owed (30%) carry far more weight.

These are general weights and vary by person.

What's one credit rule you wish someone had explained sooner?
